system.description:
CONCENTRATE MANIPULATE SOUL VERDANT WARDING
Action 10 minutes
Target One corpse or collection of substantially complete remains
You prepare the dead according to traditional funerary practices intended to protect the remains from necromantic misuse, possession and other violations of the natural passage between life and death.
Make a Medicine, Nature or Religion check against the deceased creature's Level DC. The GM determines an appropriate DC where the creature's level is unknown.
Heroic The remains are protected for 1 year.
Critical The remains are protected for 1 month.
Success The remains are protected for 1 week.
Partial The remains are protected for 24 hours.
Failure The rite provides no protection.
Fumble Something has been incorrectly prepared. You cannot attempt Lay to Rest upon those remains again until your next daily preparation.
While protected, an effect attempting to animate the remains as an Undead creature, possess the remains or bind another soul into them must first successfully Counteract your Lay to Rest.
Lay to Rest does not prevent ordinary decomposition, prevent communication with the dead, prevent resurrection, compel a departed soul to remain or depart, destroy an existing Undead creature or affect an Undead creature that has already been created from the remains.

Rolled as a skill action from Medicine, Nature or Religion (10 minutes) against the deceased creature's Level DC; the card prints the protection ladder.
